name: GhostFileUploadItemRemove
description: Native button (type=button) that removes its item's file. Named by messages.removeLabel (Remove {name}) unless the consumer sets aria-label or aria-labelledby. After removal, focus moves to the next item's remove button, then the previous one, then the trigger.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Optional visible text. The accessible name should begin with it (WCAG 2.5.3).

keyboard.Enter: Removes the file and moves focus.
keyboard.Space: Removes the file and moves focus.

spec.evidence: Zac approved the GHO-106 design plan in chat on 2026-11-17 (recorded in GHO-210), including its six review points. See the Status line in this spec.
